_private_canary_repo: Proves the credential still has private visibility. Identity drift degrades a token to public-only, under which public repos keep answering and private ones 404 - so the scan completes and reports rows that are quietly wrong. Nothing else in the run detects that.
_legacy_protection_canary: Proves the run can tell 'no legacy branch protection' apart from 'lost Administration:read'. GitHub masks a 403 here as a bare 'Not Found', so without this probe a token that quietly lost the permission would report every branch unprotected, forever, with no error.
_sentinel_repositories: Must appear in every enumeration. windows-certificate-store-exporter is deliberate: it carries 4 required contexts and typically has zero open PRs, so it is the repo D2 is most likely to be silently blind to.
_minimum_repository_count: Gross-failure floor only (21 repos as of 2026-07-20). Precision is the canary's job: a public-only token would still clear a count-based floor, since 18 of 21 repos are public.
_fresh_head_grace_minutes: Measured against the head COMMIT's age, not the PR's updated_at - a comment bumps updated_at, so an active PR could otherwise defer past its own grace indefinitely. Observed: checks post within ~2 minutes, startup_failure within seconds.
